summary: slow startup typing performance when explorer contributions are expanded
description: Windows, Insiders build 1.18.0-insiders commit 4b0145 date 2017-10-19 I noticed that on startup, there is a delay to typing. The editor comes up, but when I start typing it takes a few seconds for the letters to appear.
